Closers without openers: a* b/ c_ d+ e= f~ ]] }}} @@ >> >>> \) $ ]
Storms: ***** ///// _____ +++++ ===== ~~~~~ [[[[[ ]]]]] {{{{{ $$$$$ \\\\\ <<<<< >>>>> @@@@@
Alternating: *a/b*c/ =a~b=c~ [[a*b]]c* *a [[b* c]] d
Link swallowing markup: *a [[b][c* d]] e* and =a [[b=]] c=
Description closing early: [[a][b]]c]] [[a][b ]] c]]
Brackets in paths: [[a[b]] [[a]b]] [[a][b[c]d]]
Escaped at the end: [[a\]] [[a\\]] [[a\\\]]]
Sub/superscript edge: a_ a^ _ ^ a_{ a^{ a_( a^( a_{}b a^()b ^{x}
Entity edge: \ \\ \_ \a1 \alpha\beta\gamma \alpha$x$
Backslash before a line break: a \\\\

Long verbatim with every opener inside: =*a /b _c +d ~e [[f {{{g @@h: <<i [fn:j \k $l=
